Going right, the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (2,5). So the line goes down.
The line must go left: right is number 6, which comes later.
Going around the edge to (2,5), the next 8 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (2,4). So the line goes down.
Going around the edge to (3,5), the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at number 5. So the line goes down.
Going around the edge to (4,5), the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,5). So the line goes down.
Number 5 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going down leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes left.

Going down would leave both number 6 and cell (2,5) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going around the edge to (5,4) would force the line onto number 7 before its turn. So the line goes left.
Number 6 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
